BEGIN;

-- Original UUID values are intentionally removed by the up migration.
-- Recreate deterministic synthetic UUIDs so the pre-cleanup schema can be restored.
ALTER TABLE i18n ADD COLUMN legacy_uuid uuid;
UPDATE i18n
SET legacy_uuid = ('00000000-0000-0000-1000-' || lpad(to_hex(id), 12, '0'))::uuid;
ALTER TABLE i18n ADD CONSTRAINT i18n_legacy_uuid_key UNIQUE (legacy_uuid);

ALTER TABLE tag ADD COLUMN legacy_uuid uuid;
UPDATE tag
SET legacy_uuid = ('00000000-0000-0000-2000-' || lpad(to_hex(id), 12, '0'))::uuid;
ALTER TABLE tag ADD CONSTRAINT tag_legacy_uuid_key UNIQUE (legacy_uuid);

ALTER TABLE tech ADD COLUMN legacy_uuid uuid;
UPDATE tech
SET legacy_uuid = ('00000000-0000-0000-3000-' || lpad(to_hex(id), 12, '0'))::uuid;
ALTER TABLE tech ADD CONSTRAINT tech_legacy_uuid_key UNIQUE (legacy_uuid);

ALTER TABLE tech_version ADD COLUMN legacy_uuid uuid;
UPDATE tech_version
SET legacy_uuid = ('00000000-0000-0000-4000-' || lpad(to_hex(id), 12, '0'))::uuid;
ALTER TABLE tech_version ADD CONSTRAINT tech_version_legacy_uuid_key UNIQUE (legacy_uuid);

COMMIT;
